articles.summary: Pangolin 1.26 adds resource session management, continuous IdP session revalidation, SSH session command logs, automatic updates on Windows, custom DNS records on delegated domains, and custom auth page domains for self-hosted.

articles.title: How to Require Client Certificates (mTLS) on a Pangolin Resource
